description: This PHP class defines an ORM entity 'ReportTo' representing supervisor-subordinate relationships between employees within an HR management system. It includes properties for supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method, along with accessor and mutator methods.

classes.name: ReportTo
classes.description: An ORM entity representing a reporting relationship between two employees with a specific reporting method.

methods.name: getSupervisor
methods.description: Returns the supervisor employee in the relationship.

methods.name: setSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee in the relationship.

methods.name: getSubordinate
methods.description: Returns the subordinate employee in the relationship.

methods.name: setSubordinate
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee in the relationship.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Returns the reporting method used for this relationship.

methods.name: setReportingMethod
methods.description: Sets the reporting method for this relationship.
